subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose trimmed operator-authored per-agent descriptions to authorized callers as the supported dynamic-discovery contract?
rationale: The field already exists in configuration, but making it available to agent callers defines a durable tool-output and metadata-disclosure contract.

options.title: Adopt the narrow discovery output
options.body: Rebase and review the open PR so authorized `agents_list` callers receive nonblank configured descriptions.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Reject runtime disclosure and close the request after documenting that descriptions remain operator metadata outside the tool contract.

options.title: Define a different discovery contract
options.body: Specify a bounded or separately curated capability field before accepting any tool-output expansion.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow discovery output
recommendation.body: Rebase and review the open PR so authorized `agents_list` callers receive nonblank configured descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail most directly connects this person to the current agent-list and multi-agent runtime boundary.
